generic_registers.title: Generic registers
generic_registers.description: Device: {device}. Entities in this draft: {entity_count}. Add, edit, or remove, then save to reload. unique_id does not change on edit. Remove does not delete the registry row (history stays).

generic_opt_pick.title: Select entity
generic_opt_pick.description: Mode: {mode}. unique_id is the history key.

generic_opt_remove.description: Drop {unique_id} from this generic device. The entity registry row is not deleted; the entity will become unavailable so history is not split.

generic_opt_entity.description: Entities in this draft: {entity_count}. Holding and input registers only (no coils).

generic_opt_core.description: Type: {entity_type}. unique_id on edit is {unique_id} and cannot change. Address is the same number as YAML address: — the Modbus address we read.

generic_export.title: Export YAML template
generic_export.description: Device: {device}. Writes a normal Modbus Manager template (same unique_id suffixes) to config/modbus_manager/templates/. Download is a signed link in the notification (valid 1 hour).

menu_options.generic_export_close: Done — YAML written. Download YAML in the notification (link valid 1 hour).

remove_device.title: Remove device
remove_device.description: Choose a device to drop from this hub. Other devices stay. The last remaining device cannot be removed — delete the hub instead.

remove_device_confirm.title: Remove this device?
remove_device_confirm.description: Remove {device} from this hub. The Home Assistant device is deleted. Entity registry rows for this device are cleaned on reload. Other devices and Combined Device entries are not changed.
